title: The Punjabi Geet Toxicity Dataset (PGT-FG): Fine-Grained Multimodal Annotations for Toxic Content in Punjabi Songs
abstract: arXiv:2610.32513v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Resources for toxicity detection in Punjabi remain limited, particularly for musical content that combines linguistic and multimodal information. We present the Punjabi Geet Toxicity Dataset (PGT-FG), a segment-level resource developed to support research on toxicity detection in Punjabi musical content. The dataset was constructed from publicly available Punjabi songs collected from YouTube. An initial collection of 620 songs resulted in 465 successfully downloaded songs and 3,402 preliminary segments from 450 songs. After quality control and annotation, the final dataset contains 2,396 unique segments from 392 songs. Four native Punjabi annotators produced 2,870 annotation records, including a shared subset of 158 segments annotated by all four. Each annotation includes binary toxicity, eight fine-grained toxicity categories, severity, sentiment, mode, and an uncertainty flag. Inter-annotator agreement was measured with Fleiss' kappa o

translated_title: 旁遮普Geet毒性数据集（PGT-FG）：针对旁遮普歌曲中有毒内容的细粒度多模态标注
translated_abstract: 旁遮普语的毒性检测资源仍然有限，特别是对于结合了语言信息与多模态信息的音乐内容。我们提出了旁遮普Geet毒性数据集（PGT-FG），这是一个段级资源，旨在支持旁遮普音乐内容毒性检测的研究。该数据集基于从YouTube收集的公开旁遮普歌曲构建而成。最初收集了620首歌曲，其中465首成功下载，并从450首歌曲中提取出3,402个初步片段。经过质量控制和标注流程后，最终数据集包含来自392首歌曲的2,396个独特片段。四名以旁遮普语为母语的标注者共产生了2,870条标注记录，其中包括158个由所有四名标注者共同标注的共享片段子集。每条标注包含二元毒性标签、八个细粒度毒性类别、严重程度、情感、模式以及不确定性标志。标注者间一致性使用Fleiss' kappa进行测量（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文提出了首个面向旁遮普歌曲毒性检测的段级多模态数据集PGT-FG，包含2,396个经四名母语标注者标注的片段，涵盖八类细粒度毒性类别及严重程度、情感等多维度标注，填补了旁遮普语音乐内容毒性检测资源的空白。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces PGT-FG, the first segment-level multimodal dataset for toxicity detection in Punjabi songs, featuring 2,396 segments annotated by four native Punjabi annotators with eight fine-grained toxicity categories along with severity, sentiment, and uncertainty flags, filling a critical gap in Punjabi toxicity detection resources.
